# Dragoon's Town 0.29 release notes

## Visible business growth

- Direct purchases that cross the existing 25, 100 or 1,000-location architectural stages now show a brief scaffold-and-builder moment on the town map.
- First openings keep their celebration, while ordinary successful purchases keep their delivery.
- Large direct purchases show only one bounded construction moment even when several visual stages are crossed.

## Comfort and compatibility

- The construction moment follows the existing Off/Low/Full and Life pause controls.
- Reduced motion, battery saver, browser backgrounding and Android lifecycle pauses stop the effect.
- Decorative artwork is hidden from assistive technology and cannot capture taps.
- Existing saves, business counts, prices, income, prestige, milestones, artwork, Android package and original signing identity remain compatible.
- Real payments and ads remain disabled.

Browser and compatible Android publication will follow only after complete source, viewport, mobile-touch, package and signature checks pass. Physical Android 13/Thor testing remains separate and is not claimed by automated verification.
